exact_signatures: stored_strict_grid_mask (n : Nat) (R s : Rational) (hR : 0<R) (x : Word(n+1)) : contract(denoteChain(produceComparison n (strictCut(n+1,R,s))).run.value) x 0 0 = if -R+2*R*wordValue(x)/2^(n+1)<s then 1 else 0

stored_inclusive_grid_mask (n : Nat) (R s : Rational) (hR : 0<R) (x : Word(n+1)) : contract(denoteChain(produceComparison n (inclusiveCut(n+1,R,s))).run.value) x 0 0 = if -R+2*R*wordValue(x)/2^(n+1)<=s then 1 else 0

SOURCE: positive radius, supplied by actual allocatedRadius_positive when composed

definitions: Strict cut=min N Nat.ceil((s+R)/step). Inclusive cut=min N(if quotient<0 then0 else Nat.floor(quotient)+1). Guard is literal clipping of a negative inclusive endpoint. CutN retained as Nat, not FinN.
full_source_remaining: These masks specialize to A,B,C and complementD for arbitrary T0/T1 without ordering hypotheses. Full piecewise polynomial product/directsum consumer still open.
